strict_acceptance: Open GPS + barometric altitude only if separate saved no-height source receipt says admitted_for_separately_frozen_negative_control true, >=10 independent biological birds, correct source IDs SHA, all original 9 seasonal GPS files and MD5.

lowmotion_source_selection.source_UTC_first5min_rule: Earliest valid bird/source/XY/time speed event per bird/date/5min bin, no later fallback if altitude missing
lowmotion_source_selection.horizon: All original source calendar days, no year or breeding filter
lowmotion_source_selection.source_birds: Only preheight 28-bird original 5km flight-eligible names, then the height-unaware low-motion eligible subset
lowmotion_source_selection.source_per_cell_support: at least10 same bird other UTC date 5min events and10 other bird other UTC date events
lowmotion_source_selection.source_day_support: >=50 GPS events/day at same supported 5km cells

post_qc_d1.native_event_identity: Same source x-y/timestamps for both measurement channels; daily medians computed per sensor over same paired original low-motion records
post_qc_d1.scorer: EXACT ORIGINAL `france_gyps_2019_dualsensor_identity.py` D1-balanced native height source self vs other day heldout bird profiles. No score engine changes.
post_qc_d1.null: 999 full bird-day individual-label permutations within exact UTC calendar date, from existing validated `d1.permute_labels` scorer; recompute scoring and eligible units each draw
post_qc_d1.family_correction: Holm exactly two native height fields, unavailable contributes p=1
post_qc_d1.success_requirement: Both native height modalities have positive observed−null mean and Holm p<.05, with ≥10 unique birds and ≥950 valid null per field
post_qc_d1.permitted_unavailable: Any fixed low-motion source >=10 or height/quality/null gate not satisfied => terminal UNAVAILABLE, no further threshold search.

cross_mode_quality.comparison: Original flight result remains 27 birds/5205 days/364520 GPS fixes, Holm p=.002 in both modalities; no change to original study. Report overlap of eligible bird IDs and difference in raw gains descriptively only.
cross_mode_quality.necessary_boundary: Flight and low-motion differ in path, behavior, time and event opportunity, so a difference between two raw scores is NOT a statistical conditional speed effect.
cross_mode_quality.no_causal_behavioral_state: 0–1m/s GPS speed does not identify perched/on-ground state without acceleration, so all findings called low-motion control.

not_claimed: Independent ecological test: target source and original flight birds are the same tracking network
Independent physical GPS/barometric sensors: same tag may calibrate pressure height from GPS
Ecological absence of flight individuality if low-motion source unavailable
Full original flight individual signal explained by tag/roost if low-motion source positive
